$comment: Lane 2 (plan 09 §5.2; plan 10 A11a): model-graded cases on the fixture manual league. Expectation kinds: skills/README.md#lane-2-cases.

cases.prompt: How did last week's advice do?
cases.setup: Week 3 is final; the log holds a lineup call and a stream call for week 3 (from the Lane 1 dry runs).

expectations.text: Leads with per-player error, swap regret and the P(active) Brier; states no P(win) calibration figure as a number while its n is under 30.

cases.prompt: How did we do this week?
cases.setup: The week under review still has games to play (final: false).

expectations.text: Labels every number provisional and says when to ask again.

cases.prompt: You told me to start Kenneth Walker III and he scored 3 points. Were you wrong?
cases.setup: The logged call's Δ interval favoured Walker, who scored 3 points while the benched option scored 14.

expectations.text: Distinguishes decision quality from outcome: the call was right on the information and interval available, the outcome was bad luck; quotes the logged recommendation as read-back text rather than restating it as a new instruction.
